images.after: What you give up: Public Service Loan Forgiveness
images.title: The four PSLF requirements
images.alt: Four cards summarising PSLF rules: qualifying employer, full-time hours of at least 30 a week, federal Direct Loans only, and 120 qualifying payments.
images.caption: Refinancing with a private lender ends PSLF eligibility for those loans, and it can't be reversed.
images.note: Rules have been changing; check studentaid.gov for what applies to you

items.title: Employer
items.text: Government at any level, a 501(c)(3), or certain public-service non-profits

items.title: Hours
items.text: Full-time, meaning an average of at least 30 hours a week

items.title: Loans
items.text: Federal Direct Loans only. Private loans never qualify

items.title: Payments
items.text: 120 under a qualifying plan; they don't have to be consecutive

images.after: What SoFi offers residents and fellows
images.title: How the resident refinance works
images.alt: Flow of SoFi's resident refinance as described in the article: small fixed payment in training, unpaid interest added to principal, then regular payments.
images.caption: The low payment during training can leave you owing more when full payments start than when you refinanced.
images.note: Check SoFi's page for current terms and eligibility

items.label: Refinance in training
items.text: MD, DO, DMD or DDS in an approved residency or fellowship

items.label: Small fixed payment
items.text: Lasts a capped number of years and may not cover monthly interest

items.label: Interest added
items.text: Unpaid interest at the end of residency joins your principal

items.label: Regular payments
items.text: You pay over the term you chose

images.title: Unsure where you'll work? Compare the risks
images.alt: Comparison of waiting to refinance, which costs some interest, against refinancing federal loans too early, which can cost forgiveness.
images.caption: Refinancing can be done later at any point. Undoing it can't be done at all.

columns.label: Refinance too early
points: Could cost forgiveness on the whole balance
Payments made stop counting toward PSLF
Can't be converted back to federal
